about: The communio of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed, alleluia. So let us feast with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

a.g: Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed

ex.w003: Christus is the subject. Pascha nostrum identifies Him as our Passover, and immolatus est means “has been sacrificed”.
